sentences.en: Chestnuts have to be boiled for at least fifteen minutes.
sentences.zh: 栗子至少要煮十五分钟。

sentences.en: Each party shall consist of no less than fifteen people.
sentences.zh: 每个团队必须由不少于十五人组成。

sentences.en: His mother has been running a drugstore for fifteen years.
sentences.zh: 他母亲已经经营药店十五年了。

phrases.zh: 十五（用于表示持续时间）
